content.title: Lowe’s Will Close Stores on Easter Sunday, Giving Associates a Day Off for the Seventh Year | Lowe’s Corporate
content.text: Skip to main content Story Image Story Image Story Image Home Newsroom Stories Inside Lowe's Lowe’s Will Close Stores on Easter Sunday, Giving Associates a Day Off for the Seventh Year Mar 25, 2026 Lowe’s Will Close Stores on Easter Sunday, Giving Associates a Day Off for the Seventh Year Madelaine Vander WoudeMar 25, 2026 Share: FacebookXLinkedInEmailCopy Link Lowe’s will close all stores on Easter Sunday, April 5, so associates can take the day off and spend it with the people who matter most. This is the seventh year in a row Lowe’s has made this commitment, and it is one way the company recognizes the teams who support customers and communities throughout the year, especially during the busy spring season. What customers should know Stores will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5. Customers can still shop and find project ideas anytime at Lowes.com. Stores will reopen the next day with regular hours. Closing stores on Easter Sunday is a small pause in a busy season, but it reflects Lowe’s continued focus on associate well-being and recognition. The holiday closure underscores the company’s commitment to supporting the teams who keep stores running and serve customers every day.
